records.note: Deployment minutes before, degraded auth health, matching assertion errors. Three independent kinds.
Degraded connector plus a stall signature. A restart is the supported action even with no deployment.
A recent analytics deployment exists; the defect is longstanding and health is fine. Blaming the deployment is the trap.
Only a similar past incident points anywhere. Precedent is not causal evidence.
A diagnosis is reachable — stale data behind a healthy surface — but nothing identifies an action. Hypothesis yes, remediation no.
Tickets assert an outage; health contradicts them. The contradiction should be named, not resolved by siding with the reporters.

The reporter names a version that does not exist. The real deployment evidence does support a rollback — the point is that the recommendation must rest on evidence, not on the demand, and policy validates the target separately.
